_doc: Verdicts beside the Jev harvest sitting over Taft College (typesafe-smoke.yml run 39204968617, 2026-10-19 05:48Z; artifact jev-harvest, harvest_taft.json; 24 records failing a machine check, 24 asked, 0 errors; page text for all 24). Each verdict is a SESSION's reading (S421 SkyTupelo) of the committed record's score and the first reader's notes, which quote the page; the session did not read the catalog page itself, and Sam has not read these. 'agree': the record's evidence supports Jev's cause and owner; 'owner_differs': the cause holds, the fix belongs elsewhere; 'cause_differs': the evidence names another cause; 'unverified': the record alone cannot settle it. No gate is set.
verdicts_by: session S421 (SkyTupelo), from the records' scores and notes; not Sam

rows.title: Art
rows.evidence: 12 against a printed 18: the section is headed 'Select 18 units from the following' over three sub-lists of at least 3, 3 and 6, and the umbrella rule was not recorded as a block. The blocks were misread (choose_block_misread); the owner is the extraction, as Jev says.

rows.title: Occupational Safety and Health
rows.evidence: 18 plus no general education against a printed degree total of 60, and no GE pattern on the page. The cause holds. The fix is a local-degree GE step in Taft's procedure (the catalog's Local General Education Pattern is 27 units, per the first reader's note on 38662), after a page read of its wording, as Taft's Cal-GETC step was built. S422 SkyWillow read the catalog (college-page-read 39215793482, 39216772779, 39217374801; kb/college_reads/taft_local_ge_units.json): the catalog states two local patterns. Its Associate Degree and General Education Philosophy page prints 'Local General Education Pattern' / 'General Education Requirements (27 units – one course from each category)', and its Other Associate Degrees page says the Career Technical Education degrees, Energy Technology and Occupational Safety and Health among them, 'follow the local general education pattern of only 18 units'. Neither A.S. page states a GE figure (Occupational Safety and Health names no general education at all), and no page words the 60 as a minimum. With 18 the sums are 36 and 53 against 60, so no catalog-cited step passes them: only Title 5's 'at least 60' with 24 and 7 units of electives the pages never name would, which is the under-sum a dropped block also produces (Fable's advice, S422). No step was built. The two pages' 27 and 18 are a catalog-figures disagreement for the college, and the two records stay failing on the evidence.

reading: Jev's cause held on 15 of the 21 rows the evidence settles (12 agree, 3 owner_differs) and missed on 6: it names excerpt_cut where the text belongs to another program (38661, 38662), and record_right_check_misfires where the extraction dropped a total the page prints (30015) or the excerpt was cut (31290). Owner leans wrong the same way as at Cañada: the scorer or the extraction for a figure a procedure step supplies (16725, 36928) or a page the reader cut (44006). One fix for two rows: Taft's local-degree general education pattern (27 units per the catalog, by the first reader's note on 38662), read from the page first, then a reconcile step beside the Cal-GETC one. S422: the local-degree GE step was not built; the catalog prints 27 on its GE page and 18 for CTE degrees, and no page words the 60 as a floor (16725's evidence). S424 SkyBuckthorn, 2026-10-19 (college page reads 39250246074, 39252547290; capture-only read 39252972758): the four wrong-page rows settle three ways. 30284 Administrative Services II has its own page, which prints BUSN 1050 and 1055 where the file lists BUSN 550 and 555 (same titles and units), so the General Business page won on the old codes in its note; Taft's course_renumbers now maps the pair. 38661 CSU GE-Breadth and 38662 IGETC are not in the 2026-2027 catalog, which lists Cal-GETC alone (45358 holds its own record); 38661's loaded row duplicates the Cal-GETC text under the wrong number and is to be removed under the S411 receipt procedure. 46186 Speech Language Pathology Aide and 46198 Assistant: no page names them. The three are the college's to settle in COCI.
